company.name: Latchel
company.shortDescription: Latchel provides a property management software that helps streamline maintenance and work orders.
company.description:
Latchel provides an operations platform intended to track maintenance and vendor selection. The company's platform provides maintenance tracking and vendor selection services by property management companies to track maintenance requests, increase net margins, and increase renter satisfaction via mobile application, enabling users to connect automatically with the tenants.

Latchel was founded on 2016 and is based in Seattle, Washington.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,643,175 to $141,830,202, a 38.93x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 39 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
